_how: Courses listed under a term's notOffered are treated as not offered that term, even if the Schedule of Classes lists a section. "substitutions" lists department substitutions that apply every term: the course on the left can be filled by the courses on the right, which are offered first. Use course codes like "ARE 312". "agiCourses" lists Agricultural Institute courses to hide everywhere (courses whose catalog text says AGI or Agricultural Institute are hidden automatically).
